title: A soulful and smart guide through Barcelona
text: We had a wonderful time with Brendan . His knowledge of history, the area and the cuisine was impressive, but more importantly he brings a soulful appreciation to culture. He delivers an informative, personal and fun experience.
author: E8658KEstevew

title: Fun, food, and wine off the beaten path!
text: Brendan had us engaged from the minute we met him. He shared with us his journey to Spain and why he loved living here! As we walked around off the beaten path, we learned many interesting facts about our surroundings. The wine tasting was so amazing we ordered a case! I would encourage everyone I know to book this activity with Brendan!
author: lydiahO9739RR

title: Wine, Food and Fun
text: Brendan is a lovely, smart, informative and fun guide. He wanted to be sure we had a great time and got the most out of our visit with him. We had great pastries, learned interesting things about Barcelona and had an exceptional cava and wine tasting. I cannot express how delightful our experience with Brendan was! He’s a gem.
author: Z4956ENingridd

title: Brendon’s travel tour review
text: Brendon is an absolute amazing tour guide we loved touring with him. His wealth of knowledge and historical sites he took us were amazing. Not to mention the fabulous pastry we had at a beautiful pastry shop. Also we bought delicious chocolate there. He also took us to a wine shop that we had a cheese and cava and wine tasting at. The owner of the shop Joanne was fabulous as well. Brendon has a lovely personality. It helps as a tour guide.
author: D6212NLoliviad

title: Savor the Flavor of Barcelona with Brendan and Joan's Exquisite Wine Tour!
text:
Our wine tasting tour with Brendan and Joan was nothing short of spectacular. Brendan, with his humor and kindness, did more than just guide us through the historical landscapes of Barcelona; he connected us with the vibrant local culture of today. His personal stories of life in Barcelona added a unique and engaging layer to our experience.

author: Brandee_B

title: Great wine tasting experience
text: This was a highlight of our trip to Barcelona. It was so much fun. There was no need to drive to a winery. The experience was brought to us. All our questions were answered. The cheese and chocolates were a great compliment. Brendan organized a wonderful experience and is knowledgeable of history, fun facts and locals
author: Debra_G

title: Excellent wine and cheese tasting in Barcelona
text:
Very good option for those looking to discover wines and different locations in Spain.
The sommelier, Joan, offers different types of wines (cava, white and red) from different regions of Spain, pairing with different types of cheese.
It was definitely worth a lot!
author: André B

title: Great experience
text: Highly recommend this walking tour and wine tasting. Brendan was personable and friendly. Joan was a knowledgeable and gracious host in his wine cellar.
author: Tamara_S

title: Delicious Tasting, Great Conversation, Incredible Value
text:
Was absolutely blown away by this tour. Brendan was our tour guide who showed us around the Roman and Gothic quarters of Barcelona before taking us to visit the oldest candy and pastry shop in the city, and finally to an incredible wine bar: Aguita. At the pastry shop we had the chance to sample fresh candies made from honey and a traditional sugar pastry with a cream filling. The sweets were good, but loved the experience in the shop even more.

author: mirandadQ3517PL

title: Brilliant tour - Brendan is amazing!
text:
Brendan was such a knowledgeable and friendly guide. We had so much more than just a wine tasting experience - He showed us around some local historic sites, including Roman ruins and a few historically significant shops before making our way to the wine cellar. 
 
He was more than happy to take all of our questions throughout and by the experience it felt like less of a tour, and more of a conversation with a really knowledgeable friend! Highly recommend this experience & we'll definitely be doing more of Brendan's tours next time we're in Barcelona!
author: Aaron_T
